display.purpose: Home hero lockup only. Poppins target, system-ui fallback until fonts are bundled.

metric.purpose: Big dashboard numbers and scores; always tabular figures.

korean.purpose: Recognized Hangul and vocabulary fronts; sized up for stroke legibility.

label.purpose: Eyebrow pills and metric captions; the only uppercase/tracked role.

shadows.name: dock-lift
shadows.purpose: Navy tab dock floating over warm paper.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (the --ease curve).

motion.name: micro
motion.purpose: Tab button selection fade; micro-interactions sit in the 150-300ms band.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Below this the tab dock compacts (smaller icons, tighter padding).

breakpoints.name: landscape
breakpoints.purpose: Home/Dashboard/Review switch from stacked column to side-by-side row layout. Tablet-first, landscape-first.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:0 24px; border:1px solid #3F51D6; border-radius:999px; background:#3F51D6; color:#FFFFFF; font-family:Inter,'Noto Sans KR',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:15px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .19s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.85,0.25,1), opacity .19s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#3343C0; border-color:#3343C0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(63,81,214,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity:.78; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action; quiet next to the primary pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:0 24px; border:1px solid #E7DFCB; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:#2E2C25; font-family:Inter,'Noto Sans KR',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:15px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .19s cubic-bezier(0.22,0.85,0.25,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#F4ECD7; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(63,81,214,0.35); }

components.name: Eyebrow Pill
components.description: Tinted chip for eyebrows, status, and filters. Tone-derived alpha fill.
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-block; padding:7px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(63,81,214,0.10); border:1px solid rgba(63,81,214,0.33); color:#3F51D6; font-family:Inter,'Noto Sans KR',system-ui,sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:12px; letter-spacing:0.5px; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Warm surface container; flat at rest on a soft warm shadow. Never nested.
components.html:
Weekly progress

Keep improving your Korean writing today.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#FFFDF6; border:1px solid #E7DFCB; border-radius:20px; padding:24px; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(80,66,30,0.07); font-family:Inter,'Noto Sans KR',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-card__t { margin:0 0 8px; color:#2E2C25; font-weight:800; font-size:18px; } .ds-card__b { margin:0; color:#645F52; font-size:15px; font-weight:500; }

components.name: Metric Tile
components.description: A learning stat, not a SaaS KPI. Tone-tinted surface + accent value. Rotate pen/gold/green/teal.
components.css: .ds-metric { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; min-width:145px; padding:16px; border-radius:14px; background:rgba(63,81,214,0.08); border:1px solid rgba(63,81,214,0.20); font-family:Inter,'Noto Sans KR',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-metric__v { color:#3F51D6; font-weight:800; font-size:34px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-metric__c { color:#645F52; font-size:15px; font-weight:500; }

components.name: Floating Tab Dock
components.description: Navy pill floating over warm paper; pen circle marks the active tab.
components.css: .ds-dock { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; height:64px; padding:0 14px; border-radius:999px; background:#23244D; border:1px solid rgba(255,253,246,0.16); box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(35,36,77,0.30); } .ds-dock__item { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:50px; height:50px; border-radius:999px; } .ds-dock__item--active { background:#3F51D6; }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Pen track when on, warm line track when off; whole row is the target.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display:inline-flex; width:56px; height:32px; padding:3px; border-radius:999px; background:#3F51D6; justify-content:flex-end; } .ds-toggle--off { background:#E7DFCB; justify-content:flex-start; } .ds-toggle__knob { width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:999px; background:#FFFFFF; }

narrative.overview: SonGul is a tablet where a learner writes Korean by hand, so the whole system bends toward one act: pen meeting paper. The page is warm cream (#FBF6E9), the ink is a single confident blue (#3F51D6), and everything else (the dashboard, the review cards, the settings) is the quiet margin around that act. Depth is carried by soft warm shadows, as if a sheet were lifting off a desk, never by cool drop-shadows or glass. The mood is a patient tutor's notebook: unhurried, legible, bilingual by default, with Korean and English sitting as equals on the same ruled line. This system rejects two things by name: it is not a generic SaaS dashboard (no cool navy-and-grey corporate chrome, no KPI-card coldness), and it is not childish ed-tech (no sticker soup, no cartoon gradients). Friendliness comes from warmth and the mascot, never from juvenility.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper world: every surface, border, and shadow tints toward the paper hue, never cool.
One pen: #3F51D6 is the single action color, used for primary actions, active state, and selection only.
Restraint with warmth: calm density, generous whitespace, friendliness from color temperature and copy rather than decoration.
Bilingual equals: Hangul and Latin share the scale; Korean legibility is first-order.
Soft lift, not hard shadow: warm brown-tinted elevation, flat at rest.

rules.name: The Warm Paper Rule
rules.body: Every surface, border, and shadow tints warm, toward the paper hue. A cool grey or blue-white anywhere (#F8FAFF, #EEF3FF, #DDE4F2, #BBC8F7) is a regression, not a choice.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: #3F51D6 is the only action/brand color. Primary buttons, active nav, current selection, links, focus. It is never used for decoration, and no second saturated blue is introduced to balance it.

rules.name: The Bilingual Equals Rule
rules.body: Korean and the learner's language share scale and weight on the same line; neither is shrunk, greyed, or treated as a parenthetical. Korean glyphs may be sized up for stroke clarity, never down.

rules.name: The System-Sans Rule
rules.body: One sans carries everything: headings, buttons, labels, body, data. No display or script face appears in UI labels, buttons, or numeric data.

rules.name: The Warm Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadow color is always warm (rgba(80,66,30) family), never grey or pure black. If a shadow looks cool or hard-edged, it's wrong.

dos: Do keep every surface, border, and shadow warm (paper hue). Body is #FBF6E9; cards are #FFFDF6; borders are #E7DFCB.
Do reserve Pen Blue (#3F51D6) for actions, active state, and selection only (the One Pen Rule).
Do verify contrast in both light and dark themes independently. Body text >=4.5:1, large/bold >=3:1. Bump toward Ink before going lighter.
Do pair every semantic color with text or an icon (score, error, success), never color alone.
Do use warm, brown-tinted shadows (rgba(80,66,30) family) and flat-at-rest surfaces.
Do size Korean for stroke legibility and keep it equal to Latin in hierarchy.
Do keep >=44pt touch targets and provide reduced-motion fallbacks (crossfade/instant) for every animation.
donts: Don't let it read as a generic SaaS / analytics dashboard: no cool navy-and-grey corporate chrome, no KPI-card template, no metrics-for-managers coldness.
Don't drift childish / cartoonish: no primary-color sticker soup, no cartoon gradients, no gamified carnival. Educational and credible, not juvenile.
Don't introduce cool greys or blue-whites anywhere (#F8FAFF, #EEF3FF, #DDE4F2, #BBC8F7, cool rgba shadows). They are the pre-realign regression.
Don't tone a metric value (or any text) with Navy in dark mode, it vanishes into the background. Use a mid-tone.
Don't gamify encouragement into a slot machine; streaks and goals are warm and quiet, not loud rewards.
Don't put display/script fonts in UI labels, buttons, or numeric data; one sans carries all of it.
Don't reinvent standard affordances (custom scrollbars, weird toggles, modal-first flows). Earned familiarity wins; modals are a last resort.
Don't nest cards or use cool/black hard drop-shadows; if a shadow looks like 2014 SaaS, it's wrong.
